custom_logic_notes: The Skyscraper_Fix variant adds a position check that closes the opposite direction position before opening a new one on signal reversal. The EA uses ColorAML custom indicator which displays as a colored line - buffer 0 holds values during uptrend, buffer 1 holds values during downtrend; EMPTY_VALUE in a buffer indicates the indicator is not signaling that direction. Signal is evaluated on the previous completed bar (shift=1) to avoid repainting.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorAML indicator is a custom indicator not available in standard Python libraries. Its algorithm (Adaptive Moving Average with color/trend state) must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python before the EA logic can be converted. The AML (Adaptive Moving Line) formula needs to be sourced from the indicator's .mq5 source code. Entry logic is simple once indicator values are available - it's a trend-following system that goes long on uptrend color and short on downtrend color with fixed SL/TP. The Fix variant adds opposite-position closing on reversal which is straightforward to implement. New bar detection and position counting are standard patterns.
